about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Braised Beef Shin Tacos with Chipotle
recipes.summary: Beef shin braised in chipotle and tomato until it falls apart, piled into warm corn tortillas.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in a heavy pot for 10 minutes, until deeply coloured, and lift out. Cook the onion for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, chipotle, cumin and oregano.
Add the tomatoes and stock, return the beef, cover and cook at 150°C (130°C fan) for 3 hours, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the meat into the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and fill with beef, pickled onion and coriander. Serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: beef shin is safe at 75°C and tender when it shreds; the filling should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla and chipotle labels. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: One-Pan Mexican Chicken and Rice
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs cooked with rice, tomato, corn and beans in a single pan.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pan for 6 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, taco seasoning and rice.
Add the tomatoes and stock, bring to a simmer and nestle the chicken on top. Cover and cook for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the corn and beans, scatter with cheese, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until melted.
Scatter the coriander over the finished dish and serve straight from the pan while hot.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free: check the taco seasoning label.

recipes.title: Refried Bean and Egg Tostadas
recipes.summary: Crisp corn tortillas spread with refried beans, topped with fried eggs, avocado and lime.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and bake the tortillas on a tray for 6 minutes, until crisp.
Warm the beans, garlic and cumin with a splash of water in a pan for 5 minutes, mashing until thick and spreadable.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Spread the beans on the tostadas, top with eggs, avocado, salsa and coriander and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Spiced Pork and Charred Pineapple Tacos
recipes.summary: Spiced pork fillet and charred pineapple in warm tortillas with coriander and onion.
steps: Mix the chipotle, garlic, cumin, oregano, 1 tablespoon of oil and lime juice, coat the pork and marinate for 1 hour.
Cook the pork in a very hot pan in batches for 5 minutes each, until browned and cooked through at 70°C.
Char the pineapple in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until caramelised.
Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, pineapple, onion and coriander.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C in the middle with no pink.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Huevos con Chorizo
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled eggs with crumbly spiced chorizo, served with warm tortillas.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 5 minutes, until crisp and the oil runs red. Add the spring onion for 1 minute.
Pour in the whisked eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side, until soft.
Serve the eggs in the tortillas with salsa and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Steak Bowls with Lime Rice
recipes.summary: Grilled marinated skirt steak over lime rice with beans, corn and avocado.
steps: Mix the juice of 2 limes, garlic, cumin, paprika and 1 tablespoon of oil, coat the steak and marinate for 1 hour.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, drain and stir through the remaining lime juice and coriander.
Cook the steak in the remaining oil in a very hot pan for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare, until charred and 55°C in the centre. Rest for 5 minutes and slice across the grain.
Warm the beans and corn and serve over the rice with the steak and avocado.
notes: Food safety: whole steaks are safe seared; 55°C is medium-rare, 63°C medium, 71°C well done.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Pie Pastel Azteca
recipes.summary: Layers of corn tortilla, shredded chicken, enchilada sauce and cheese baked until bubbling.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 18 minutes, until it reaches 75°C, then shred.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Mix the chicken with 1 cup of enchilada sauce, the corn and the beans.
Spread a little sauce in a baking dish and layer tortillas, filling and cheese three times, finishing with sauce and cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Rest for 10 minutes and serve with sour cream and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C right through before shredding; the pie should be steaming hot in the middle.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla and sauce labels.

recipes.title: Churrasco-Style Picanha with Garlic Rice
recipes.summary: Salted picanha roasted and sliced thinly over garlic rice with lime.
steps: Score the fat cap, slice the picanha into thick steaks and press the salt into them. Rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the rice and stir for 1 minute, then add 3 cups boiling water and cook covered for 15 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Sear the steaks fat-side down first in a very hot pan for 4 minutes, then 3 minutes per side for medium-rare, until the centre reaches 55°C. Rest for 5 minutes.
Toss the tomato, onion, vinegar and parsley. Slice the steak and serve with the rice and vinaigrette.
notes: Food safety: whole steaks are safe seared; 55°C is medium-rare, 63°C medium, 71°C well done.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Colombian Pork, Chorizo and Bean Feast Plate
recipes.summary: A hearty plate of pork, chorizo, beans, rice, fried egg, plantain and avocado.

items: 1 x 400g tinned red kidney beans, drained

steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Fry the pork belly slices in a pan for 15 minutes, turning, until crisp, browned and 70°C inside. Fry the chorizo for 8 minutes, until browned.
Simmer the beans with the garlic, tomato and spring onion for 10 minutes, until thick.
Fry the plantain in oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden, then the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set. Plate everything with the avocado.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C with no pink; chorizo and sausages should be steaming hot. Cook eggs until set.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Brazilian Garlic Prawns with Coconut Rice
recipes.summary: Garlicky prawns in a lime and coconut sauce over fragrant coconut rice.
steps: Cook the rice with 1 cup of coconut milk and 1 cup of water, covered, for 15 minutes, until tender and creamy.
Cook the garlic, capsicum and tomato in the oil for 4 minutes, until soft.
Add the prawns and 1/2 cup coconut milk and simmer for 4 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Add the lime and coriander and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Corn and Cheese Cakes Arepas de Choclo-Style
recipes.summary: Sweet corn griddle cakes with melted mozzarella, served warm with butter.
steps: Blend the corn, milk, egg, sugar and salt into a coarse batter. Stir in the polenta and rest for 10 minutes.
Heat a buttered frying pan over medium heat and pour in 1/4 cup batter per cake.
Cook for 3 minutes, scatter with mozzarella, then flip and cook for 3 minutes, until golden and the cheese melts.
Serve warm with extra butter.
notes: Food safety: the egg cooks through in the pan: cook until the cakes are set.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Feijoada-Style Black Bean and Pork Stew
recipes.summary: Black beans slowly cooked with pork, smoked sausage and bay, served with rice and orange.
steps: Brown the pork, sausage and bacon in a heavy pot for 10 minutes, until deep golden.
Add the onion and garlic for 5 minutes, then the beans, bay leaves and stock.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour 45 minutes, until the pork is tender and 70°C inside and the stew has thickened.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and serve with the stew, orange and coriander.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C inside; the stew should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free if you use a sausage labelled gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Peruvian-Style Green Rice with Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken and rice cooked in a vivid coriander and spinach sauce.
steps: Blend the coriander, spinach, garlic and chilli with 1/2 cup of the stock until smooth.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pan for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, add the rice and the green purée for 2 minutes.
Add the remaining stock, nestle in the chicken, cover and cook for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the peas for 3 minutes and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Beef Tagine with Sweet Potato and Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Beef braised with sweet potato, chickpeas, cinnamon and ginger.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in a heavy pot for 10 minutes, until deep golden, and lift out. Cook the onion for 6 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Return the beef with the tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes, until nearly tender.
Add the sweet potato and chickpeas and simmer for 30 minutes, until soft and the sauce thickens.
Scatter the coriander over the finished dish and serve straight from the pan while hot.
notes: Food safety: beef chuck is safe at 75°C and tender once soft; the tagine should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Spiced Lamb Patties with Harissa Eggs
recipes.summary: Cumin-spiced lamb patties served with harissa-spiked fried eggs and flatbread.
steps: Mix the lamb, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, garlic, parsley and salt and shape into eight small patties.
Cook the patties in the oil for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and 75°C in the centre.
Fry the eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and dot with harissa.
Warm the flatbread and serve with the patties and eggs.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C right through, with no pink. Cook the eggs until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Harissa Honey Salmon with Couscous
recipes.summary: Salmon glazed with harissa and honey, served on herby couscous.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the harissa, honey and half the lemon juice and spread over the salmon on a lined tray.
Bake for 12 minutes, until the salmon turns opaque and flakes easily.
Soak the couscous in 1 1/2 cups boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff and stir through the herbs, oil and remaining lemon juice.
Serve the salmon on the couscous with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flakes easily, or at 63°C.

recipes.title: Ras el Hanout Sweet Potato and Lentil Bake
recipes.summary: A hearty vegan bake of sweet potato and lentils in a fragrant spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and ras el hanout for 1 minute.
Tip into a baking dish with the sweet potato, lentils, tomatoes and stock and stir.
Cover and bake for 40 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 minutes, until the lentils and sweet potato are tender.
Scatter with coriander and almonds.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chicken, Chickpea and Almond Traybake
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken roasted with chickpeas, carrot and almonds with a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the chickpeas, carrot and onion with half the oil and spices in a large tray.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil and spices, set it on top and roast for 40 minutes.
Scatter with almonds and roast for 5 minutes, until the chicken is golden and reaches 75°C.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and scatter with coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Shish Tawook-Style Chicken Skewers with Toum
recipes.summary: Yoghurt-marinated chicken skewers served with garlic toum and rice.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice, paste, paprika, cumin and oil, coat the chicken and marinate for 2 hours.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill for 12 minutes, turning, until charred at the edges and the centre reaches 75°C.
Serve on the rice with toum and parsley.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; discard the raw marinade.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Shawarma-Spiced Pulled Lamb with Tahini Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder rubbed with shawarma spices and roasted until it can be pulled apart.
steps: Mix the oil, spices, garlic, lemon juice and 2 teaspoons of salt into a paste. Rub it over the lamb and marinate overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Sit the lamb in a deep tray with the stock and cover tightly with foil.
Roast for 4 hours, until the meat pulls apart and reaches 90°C, then uncover and roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 15 minutes, until crisp.
Shred and serve with yoghurt mixed with tahini.
notes: Food safety: lamb shoulder is safe at 63°C; for pulled lamb 90°C gives the best texture.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Musaqa'a-Style Eggplant, Tomato and Chickpea Bake
recipes.summary: Silky roast eggplant baked in a spiced tomato and chickpea sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Brush the eggplant with half the oil and roast on trays for 25 minutes, until golden.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and spices, then the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick.
Layer the eggplant and sauce in a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling.
Drizzle with pomegranate molasses and scatter with parsley.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Green Shakshuka with Spinach and Labneh
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in a bright green sauce of spinach, zucchini and herbs, with labneh.
steps: Cook the zucchini in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the spinach and cook for 3 minutes, until wilted, then stir in the coriander and parsley.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set.
Dollop with labneh and scatter with chilli.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Saffron Crispy Rice Tahdig with Chicken
recipes.summary: Saffron chicken under a crown of golden, crunchy rice.
steps: Mix half the yoghurt with the lemon juice, turmeric and saffron, coat the chicken and marinate for 4 hours.
Brown the chicken and onion in the butter in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, then add 1/2 cup water, cover and cook for 30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes, drain and mix a third with the remaining yoghurt, egg yolks and saffron.

Heat the oil in a non-stick pot, spread the yoghurt rice over the base, top with the chicken and remaining rice, and steam covered on low for 45 minutes, until the base is crisp and golden. Turn out onto a platter.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; the rice mixture contains raw egg yolk and cooks through, so steam until piping hot. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel Plates with Tahini
recipes.summary: Herby baked chickpea falafel with cucumber, tomato and a lemon tahini drizzle.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices, chickpea flour and baking powder into a coarse mixture.
Shape into 16 patties, set them on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp outside.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 3 tablespoons of water. Serve the falafel with cucumber, tomato and the tahini drizzle.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Chicken and Bulgur One-Pot
recipes.summary: A one-pot spiced chicken and bulgur pilaf with toasted almonds.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the bulgur and stock, return the chicken, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until the bulgur is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Scatter with almonds and parsley and serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Contains gluten (bulgur), milk and tree nuts.

recipes.title: Jerk Salmon with Coconut Rice
recipes.summary: Jerk-spiced salmon over coconut rice with lime and mango.
steps: Mix the oil, allspice, cinnamon, thyme, chilli, sugar and garlic and rub over the salmon.
Cook the rice with the coconut milk and 1 cup of water, covered, for 15 minutes, until tender.
Sear the salmon in a hot pan for 4 minutes per side, until the fish turns opaque and flakes easily.
Serve over the rice with mango and lime.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flakes easily, or at 63°C.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Dark-Sugar Braised Chicken with Thyme and Carrot
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs browned and simmered in a dark, thyme-scented sauce with carrot and capsicum.
steps: Season the chicken with the soy sauce and marinate for 1 hour.
Melt the sugar in the oil in a heavy pot for 2 minutes, until dark amber, add the chicken and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, carrot, capsicum, tomato, thyme, scotch bonnet and stock, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and serve with the stew. Remove the scotch bonnet first.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices. Keep the scotch bonnet whole and remove it before serving.

recipes.title: Jamaican-Style Beef Patties
recipes.summary: Flaky turmeric pastry filled with spiced beef and baked until golden.
steps: Rub the butter into the flour, turmeric and a pinch of salt, add the water to form a dough and chill for 30 minutes.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the mince, garlic, curry powder and thyme and cook for 10 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the stock and breadcrumbs and cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roll the pastry, cut 12cm rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges. Brush with egg yolk.
Bake for 30 minutes, until deep golden and the filling is steaming.
notes: Food safety: the mince filling must reach 75°C right through; the baked patties should be steaming hot.

recipes.title: Trini Chicken Pelau
recipes.summary: Caramelised chicken cooked with rice, black-eyed beans and coconut milk in one pot.
steps: Melt the sugar in the oil in a heavy pot for 2 minutes, until dark amber. Add the chicken and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic and curry powder for 3 minutes, then the carrot, thyme, rice and beans.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 35 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Rest for 10 minutes, fluff and scatter with coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; cool and refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Coconut Sweet Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Soft sweet potato and coconut pancakes with a pinch of nutmeg and warm syrup.
steps: Whisk the sweet potato, coconut milk and egg until smooth.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, nutmeg and coconut until just combined.
Cook 1/4 cup spoonfuls in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes per side, until golden and puffed.
Serve warm with maple syrup.
notes: Food safety: the pancakes are cooked when set through; refrigerate leftovers.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Braised Oxtail with Butter Beans
recipes.summary: Oxtail slowly braised with allspice, thyme and butter beans until the meat falls from the bone.
steps: Season the oxtail with the soy sauce, allspice, garlic and ginger and marinate overnight.
Brown the oxtail in the oil in a heavy pot in batches for 12 minutes, until deeply coloured. Cook the onion in the same pot for 5 minutes, then stir in the paste.
Return the oxtail with the stock, thyme and scotch bonnet, cover and simmer for 3 hours 30 minutes, until the meat falls from the bone. Add the beans for the last 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and serve with the oxtail. Remove the scotch bonnet first.
notes: Food safety: oxtail needs long cooking; it is safe and tender when the meat falls from the bone and the stew is steaming hot (above 75°C).
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken marinated in garlic, orange and lime mojo and roasted until the skin is crisp.
steps: Mix the garlic, orange juice, lime juice, cumin, oregano, oil and 1 teaspoon of salt. Coat the chicken and marinate for 4 hours.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Spread the potato and onion on a tray and set the chicken on top.
Roast for 45 minutes, until golden and the thickest piece reaches 75°C.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with the pan juices.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Szekely Pork and Sauerkraut Stew
recipes.summary: Hungarian pork stewed with sauerkraut, paprika and sour cream.
steps: Brown the pork in the oil in a heavy pot for 10 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion for 6 minutes, then the garlic, paprika and caraway.
Return the pork with the sauerkraut and stock, cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the pork is tender and 70°C inside.
Stir through the sour cream until just heated.
Scatter the dill over the stew and serve it hot with crusty bread or boiled potatoes.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C inside; the stew should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Rinderrouladen with Mustard and Pickles
recipes.summary: German beef rolls filled with bacon, mustard, onion and pickle, braised in gravy.
steps: Spread each beef slice with mustard and top with bacon, onion and pickle. Roll up and tie with string.
Brown the rolls in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until deeply coloured, and lift out. Stir the paste in the pot, add the wine and boil for 3 minutes.
Return the rolls with the stock, cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes, until very tender. Lift out and keep warm.
Mix the cornflour with water, whisk into the sauce and simmer for 3 minutes, until thick. Serve the rolls with the sauce and potato.
notes: Food safety: beef rolls are safe at 75°C and tender after the long braise; the bacon must be cooked through.
Gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vinegar-Marinated Beef Roast with Red Cabbage
recipes.summary: Beef marinated in vinegar and wine, then slow-cooked and served with red cabbage.
steps: Combine the wine, vinegar, onion, carrot, cloves, bay leaves and pepper with 1 cup of water, add the beef and marinate in the fridge for 3 days, turning daily.
Dry the beef and brown in the oil for 10 minutes, until deeply coloured. Add the strained marinade, stock and honey.
Cover and cook at 150°C (130°C fan) for 3 hours, until very tender and 85°C inside.
Slice, spoon over the reduced gravy and serve with the red cabbage.
notes: Food safety: beef must reach at least 63°C inside; for a tender pot roast it cooks to 85°C. Keep the marinating beef in the fridge, covered.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Bratwurst with Onion Gravy and Mash
recipes.summary: Pan-browned bratwurst with buttery mash and slow-cooked onion gravy.
steps: Cook the onion in 2 tablespoons of butter for 20 minutes, until deeply golden and sweet. Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock and mustard and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick.
Boil the potato for 18 minutes, until tender, drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Brown the bratwurst in a pan over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until golden and 75°C in the centre.
Serve the sausages on the mash with the onion gravy.
notes: Food safety: bratwurst must reach 75°C with no pink.

recipes.title: Poached Beef with Horseradish Cream
recipes.summary: Austrian-style beef gently poached with root vegetables and served with apple and horseradish cream.
steps: Place the beef, carrot, celery, onion, leek, bay leaves, pepper and salt in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a bare simmer, never a boil, and cook gently for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the beef is tender and reaches 70°C inside.
Rest the beef in the broth for 15 minutes, then slice across the grain.
Serve with the vegetables, potato, horseradish cream and apple sauce.
notes: Food safety: beef should reach at least 63°C inside; it is cooked to 70°C or more for tenderness. Keep leftovers refrigerated.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Turos Csusza Cheese Noodles with Bacon
recipes.summary: Hungarian pasta tossed with crisp bacon, ricotta and sour cream.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Fry the bacon in the butter for 8 minutes, until crisp.
Stir the ricotta and sour cream through the hot pasta until creamy.
Top with the bacon and chives.
notes: Food safety: bacon should be cooked through and crisp.

recipes.title: German Apple Oven Pancake
recipes.summary: A puffed oven pancake with cinnamon apples, served straight from the dish.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) with a 24cm ovenproof frying pan inside.
Blend the eggs, flour, milk and a pinch of salt until smooth. Cook the apples in 1 tablespoon of the butter with the sugar and cinnamon for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the remaining butter to the hot pan until melted, add the apples and pour the batter over.
Bake for 18 minutes, until puffed and golden. Dust with icing sugar.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Swiss Alpine Macaroni with Potato and Apple Sauce
recipes.summary: Macaroni, potato and melted cheese topped with crisp onions, served with apple sauce.
steps: Cook the potato in boiling salted water for 6 minutes, add the macaroni and cook for 8 minutes, until both are tender, and drain.
Fry the onions in the butter for 20 minutes, until deep golden and crisp.
Return the pasta and potato to the pot with the cream and cheese and stir over low heat for 3 minutes, until melted and creamy.
Serve topped with onions and a side of apple sauce.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Chicken, Leek and Ham Pie
recipes.summary: A golden pie of tender chicken, leek and ham in a creamy mustard sauce.
steps: Cook the leeks in the butter for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the chicken and cook for 8 minutes, until cooked through.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Add the ham and mustard and cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Fill a pie dish, cover with pastry and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 35 minutes, until golden and the filling reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C throughout; the pie should be steaming hot in the middle.

recipes.title: Sunday Lamb Leg on Crisp Potatoes
recipes.summary: A classic roast leg of lamb with garlic and rosemary over crisp roast potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Stab the lamb all over and push in the garlic and rosemary. Rub with oil, lemon juice and salt.
Roast for 20 minutes, then reduce to 180°C (160°C fan). Add the potatoes around it.
Roast for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the lamb reaches 60°C for medium or 70°C for well done and the potatoes are crisp.
Rest for 20 minutes, then carve.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; 60°C then rest takes it to about 63°C for medium. Use 70°C for well done.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Bubble and Squeak Breakfast Cakes
recipes.summary: Crisp patties of leftover potato and cabbage topped with fried eggs.
steps: Cook the onion and cabbage in half the butter for 8 minutes, until soft and golden.
Mix with the mashed potato, season and shape into four patties.
Fry the patties in the remaining butter for 5 minutes per side, until deeply crisp.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and serve on the cakes.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Glamorgan Sausages
recipes.summary: Crisp breadcrumbed leek and cheese patties, served with a mustard dip.
steps: Cook the leek in the butter for 6 minutes, until soft. Mix with the breadcrumbs, cheese, 1 egg, mustard and parsley.
Shape into eight sausages and chill for 20 minutes.
Roll in the flour, dip in the beaten second egg and coat in panko.
Fry in the oil for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and hot all the way through.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Denver Omelette
recipes.summary: A fluffy omelette with ham, capsicum, onion and cheese.
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan and cook the ham, capsicum and onion for 4 minutes, until soft.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 3 minutes, lifting the edges, until nearly set.
Scatter over the cheese, fold and cook for 1 minute, until just set. Top with chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Maple Salmon with Roast Broccoli
recipes.summary: Salmon glazed with maple and mustard over roasted broccoli and potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato and broccoli in the oil and roast on a tray for 12 minutes.
Mix the maple, mustard and soy sauce and spread over the salmon.
Add the salmon to the tray and roast for 12 minutes, until the salmon turns opaque and flakes and the potato is golden.
Serve the salmon and vegetables straight from the tray with the lemon wedges alongside.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flakes easily, or at 63°C.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Oven Pulled Pork Shoulder
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder rubbed with smoky spices and cooked low and slow until it pulls apart.
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne and salt and rub it over the pork. Rest overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Sit the pork in a deep tray with the vinegar and 1/2 cup water and cover tightly with foil.
Cook for 5 hours, until the pork reaches 93°C and shreds easily.
Shred the meat in the juices, stir through the bbq sauce and serve.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C inside; for pulled pork it is cooked to 93°C so it shreds.
Gluten-free: check the sauce label. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Red Beans and Rice with Smoked Sausage
recipes.summary: Creamy red kidney beans slowly cooked with smoked sausage, served over rice.

items: 3 x 400g tinned red kidney beans, drained

steps: Brown the sausage in a heavy pot for 6 minutes, until golden, then add the onion, capsicum and celery for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, cajun seasoning, bay leaves, beans and stock and simmer for 30 minutes, mashing some beans, until thick and creamy.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Serve the beans over the rice, scattered with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: sausages should be steaming hot (75°C) all the way through; refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free: check the seasoning label. Dairy-free.
